motion_system: A fast but silent procession is implied by evenly spaced measure cuts, onset puncture clusters, and a lower ridge pulling left to right across the slab.
color_drift: Near-black and brown-black dominate; charcoal gray carries the major marks, with rare red, white, and faint powder-blue interruptions at secondary seams.
glow_behavior: Almost no glow; only a few dry edge glints and muted red shard pressure catch the grazing light.
